correctness.rationale: Factorization into positive endomorphisms forces weighted equal-length inner images and nonunit outer lengths (s,t). Short outer lengths give A_n(s,t)≤φ^n and 2^{o(n)} outer choices. Long lengths force either a mixed inner word with s+t≤n or two pure-power words and a proper-divisor bound s+t≤n+n/p(n); number of inner words is e^{o(n)}. Explicit Fibonacci (1,2) outer code and even-length square-root maps yield matching lower rates.
residual_risks: Exact leading constants and larger alphabets remain open. Independently checked only n≤6 rather than all n.
